Namaste Ji Namaste Bhaiya song | namaste ji namaste bhaiya gana | Bhaiya Nahi Saiyaan
Namaste ji... Namaste bhaiya! Bhaiya nahi, Saiyaan! | namaste ji... namaste bhaiya! bhaiya nahin, saiyan!
You asked where to find the song, so here it is!
Sing along with Indian Diaries 1, an original Hindi/Hindustani musical comedy from WAQAS.
He wants her to call him Saiyaan, but she keeps calling him Bhaiya. And when she brings up the Rakhi... things get even more complicated!
Bhaiya = Brother
Saiyaan = Beloved / romantic partner
Rakhi = A bracelet traditionally associated with the sibling bond
